name: fiispec
description: FiiSpec — AI Standards Intelligence for Procurement (SIH 2026, SIH26108)

scripts.typecheck: next typegen && tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test:rules: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-fiispec "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-fiispec "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:start --project demo-fiispec --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit
